title: Docs/2910 Remove n00b and fix some docs
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

* Removed all `n00b` file names and all its occurrences in the text
* Since some files are renamed because of `n00b` removal we convert them to kebab-case at one go
* Added redirects

Related

* #2910 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/community/development.md#3-update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: nirname

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body: This seems weird. We're setting a 4GiB heap size limit here, but just above, we have a `mem_limit` of `'2G'`. Is this right? It seems like Docker will just limit us to 2GiB anyway.

comments.author: nirname
comments.body: Nice catch, by the way. I'll check it

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
```suggestion
### [The initialize() call](./getting-started.md#_3-calling-the-javascript-api)
```

Very minor, but should this have a `.md`? extension? (Please ignore me if this doesn't work!).

comments.author: nirname
comments.body: Across all the docs `.md` is the part of the links. So I decided to keep it consistent. This is not a link to a website anymore, which may be configured to derive data type by request headers. This is relative link to wherever the docs are hosted. I dare say, that this is done for GitHub compatibility, because [this link with md](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/intro/index.md) is working while [a link to the same file this without .md](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/packages/mermaid/src/docs/intro/index) is not

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body: You'll also need to add the correct values to `urlRedirectMap` also. That is used to redirect users who load the existing page.

comments.author: nirname
comments.body:
@sidharthv96 
It is not clear to be, what exactly I should do. urlRedirectMap contains only 2 lines here right now. What to add here?

```
const urlRedirectMap: Record<string, string> = {
  '/misc/faq.html': 'configure/faq.html',
  '/syntax/c4c.html': 'syntax/c4.html',
};
```

I have added all n00b references as the map keys

```
'n00b-gettingstarted': 'intro/getting-started',
'intro/n00b-gettingStarted': 'intro/getting-started',
```

So the first line takes care about not redirecting to wrong URL.
The second line deals with those who visited the previously existing page.

I dont understand why we need second map here
